name: The Cartographer's Lost Roads
author: Fourfold Community
description: A short side-story following the Pale Cartographer's abandoned trail. Recover a survey cache and piece together a route that predates the Sundering.

quests.name: The Lost Survey Cache
quests.description: Gather 5 Ironstone to rebuild an old survey instrument.

quests.name: Lanterns Before Dawn
quests.description: Gather 3 Lumen Shards to relight the forgotten road markers.

lore.title: Surveyor's Field Note
lore.text: The Pale Cartographer did not map places. They mapped the choices that led to them.
